entry_rationale: Pay 20 million March 2027 SOFR; Hormuz engine-room attacks versus skip-October / hike-December is the dated overnight mechanism.
entry_thesis: Hormuz engine-room attacks are still ramping into Aramco's thin buffers with WTI 103.66 and Brent 109.55, a live supply shock that should knock the Fed off the economist skip-October-then-hike-December map. Mar27 SOFR at 4.52 versus cash 3.87 only prices about 65bp of tightening, a tidy Dec-plus-a-bit path rather than an energy-war terminal, and overnight Strait/oil headlines are the dated mechanism that reprices that strip higher. CoreWeave remains a non-bank credit story on JPMorgan's limited-bank-risk read, so it does not give the Fed cover to stay easy; ECB patience and the NZ close just keep the impulse in USD rates. Pay Mar27 SOFR instead of USDCAD, which mixes CAD's oil tailwind against a hawkish Fed.

exit_rationale: Close the already-reduced March SOFR short; a surveyed hold cannot extend a 55bp cash-to-contract gap, so the residual is event noise.
invalidation: Hormuz headlines fade and crude backs off the 103.66/109.55 prints without SOFR_2027-03 moving above 4.52; CoreWeave-style stress jumps from non-bank into banks and forces a risk-off receive; or an Oct skip is delivered with dovish guidance that cuts Dec hike odds rather than preserving them.
